Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to

SPECIFICATION FOR 
DELIVERY ROLLER BOSS FOR JUTE DRAWING FRAME 



1. Scope — This standard prescribes the requirements for delivery roller boss for use in jute drawing 
frames. 

2. Manufacture 

2.1 Marer/a/— Delivery roller boss shall be manufactured from mild steel [see 15:226-1975 
'Specification for structural steel (standard quality) ( fifth revision )']. 

2.2 Heat Treatment— It shall be case hardened and minimum hardness shall be within 58 ^o 62 HRC 
wh&n determined by the method prescribed in IS : 1586-1968 'Methods for Rockwell hardness test 
{ B and C scales ) for steel ( first revision )'. 

3. Dimensional Requirements 

3-1 Nomina/ ~~The nominal dimensions of delivery roller boss shall be as agreed to between the 
manufacturer and the purchaser. In the abscence of any agreement, these shall be as declared by 
the manufacturer. 

3.2 Toierances — The nominal dimensions shall be subject to the following tolerances {see Fig. 1 ):

4. Marking — Unless Otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer, each 
delivery roller boss shall be legibly marked with manufacturer's name or trade mark. 

4.1 Standard IVIark^ Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

5, Sampling and Criteria for Conformity— Unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser 
and the manufacturer, to ascertain the conformity of delivery roller boss to the requirements of this 
specification, single sampling plan with Inspection Level 1 and Acceptance Quality Lev^l ( AQL )

of 15 percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 (Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables: 
Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count of defects ( first revision )', siiall be followed. 

6. Packing — Delivery roller boss shall be packed In such a way so as to ensure complete protection 
from rust. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been formulated with a view to provide guidance to the manufacturers and 
users of delivery roller boss for jute drawing frame. It is hoped, it would ensure manufacture of 
delivery roller boss of acceptable quality leading to improved functioning of the drawing frames.
